landing.heroTitle: Empowering Startups to Solve Public Sector Challenges
landing.heroSubtitle: A unified platform connecting government departments with innovative startups for evidence-based procurement, sandbox trials, and statewide scale.
landing.pillar1Desc: Government departments articulate real-world civic challenges with measurable performance targets.
landing.pillar2Desc: Intelligent matching and DPIIT GFR Rule 173(i) prior turnover waivers for young startups.
landing.pillar3Desc: Live trials with milestone-based e-Kosh treasury disbursements and real-world KPI tracking.
landing.pillar4Desc: Quality Control Board certification enabling statewide procurement via GeM Startup Runway.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Deploy Innovations for Maharashtra?
landing.ctaDesc: Join hundreds of innovators and civil servants driving digital transformation across 36 districts.
